description:
Tongson Bay Villas – 4-Bedroom Villa

Tongson Bay Villas is a boutique resort-style development where warm, natural wood architecture meets clean modern design. This spacious 4-bedroom villa offers a large open-air living room and bedrooms that open onto the fresh sea breeze, with direct access to a private beach and communal swimming pool. Great for families and children. 

The villa sits in a peaceful, sought-after spot, a short stroll from the quiet sands of Tongson Beach, where you can enjoy clear, calm water on a secluded stretch of private beach. Fisherman Village is 12 minutes and the airport is just 10 minutes by car, and a good selection of restaurants, shops and bars is close by. It’s an ideal base for families or groups who want tranquility without giving up convenience.

Villa Details

Location: Plaileam, Bophut, Koh Samui, Surat Thani
Type: 2-storey private villa
Living area: 250 sqm
Bedrooms: 4
Bathrooms: 3
